subject: Activating a lactate receptor eased senescence markers in progeroid mice
script: From Agewell Brief: Activating a lactate receptor eased senescence markers in progeroid mice. New research shows that activating the lactate receptor GPR81 reduces senescence markers and improves muscle performance in progeroid mice, linking metabolism to aging at the molecular level. Aging is not a single failure but a systemic loss of resilience. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
